description: Abstract class implementing a generic queue consumer template with subscription, polling, decoding, and lifecycle management for a message queue system.

classes.name: AbstractTbQueueConsumerTemplate
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing a template for consuming messages from a queue with subscription management, polling, decoding, and lifecycle controls.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Enqueues a subscription request for the topic.

methods.name: subscribe(Set<TopicPartitionInfo>)
methods.description: Enqueues a subscription request for specific partitions.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls messages from the queue, handling subscription and decoding.

methods.name: decodeRecords
methods.description: Decodes raw records into message objects.

methods.name: sleepAndReturnEmpty
methods.description: Sleeps for the remaining polling duration and returns an empty list.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is stopped.

methods.name: doPoll
methods.description: Abstract method to perform polling from the queue.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Abstract method to decode a raw record into a message.

methods.name: doSubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to handle subscription logic.

methods.name: doCommit
methods.description: Abstract method to handle commit logic.

methods.name: doUnsubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to handle unsubscription logic.

methods.name: getFullTopicNames
methods.description: Returns full topic names from partitions.

methods.name: isLongPollingSupported
methods.description: Indicates if long polling is supported; defaults to false.
